title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller - Temporary to Permanent

Location: Poole, Dorset
Salary: 33,000- 35,000 per annum equivalent, depending on experience
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:30am-5:30pm
Start date: 2nd November 2026

TeamJobs are recruiting for an experienced Credit Controller to join a fashion brand based in Poole.

This opportunity will initially be on a temporary basis, with the potential to become permanent.

What you'll be doing:
- Managing outstanding balances and chasing payments by telephone and email.
- Building positive customer relationships while ensuring timely payment.
- Resolving invoice queries and investigating payment discrepancies.
- Allocating payments and keeping customer account records accurate.
- Monitoring aged debt and supporting the finance team with reporting.
- Working closely with colleagues to resolve queries and reduce overdue debt.

What we're looking for:
- Previous experience in credit control.
- Confident communication skills and a professional telephone manner.
- Strong attention to detail and good organisational skills.
- A proactive approach to resolving queries and collecting outstanding payments.
- Confidence using Excel and finance systems.
- Availability to start from 2nd November.

Interested? Apply today or send Lucy a message to find out more

title: Customer Account Coordinator
description:
Customer Account Coordinator

Poole 30,000- 31,000 + bonus Full-time, office-based

Enjoy building customer relationships, keeping things organised and finding solutions?

TeamJobs are recruiting for a Customer Account Manager to join a business in Poole. This role focuses on looking after existing customers, managing enquiries and coordinating solutions across the business.

You'll work within a collaborative team of two Account Managers and one Customer Success Manager, with experienced colleagues providing product knowledge and support.

What you'll be doing:
- Managing customer enquiries by email and telephone.
- Preparing quotations and checking pricing, stock availability and delivery information.
- Coordinating customer requests with internal departments.
- Resolving issues proactively, exploring alternatives when products are unavailable or delayed.
- Maintaining accurate customer records across multiple systems.
- Building strong relationships with customers and colleagues.
- Managing competing priorities and following enquiries through to resolution.

What we're looking for:
- Experience in customer account support, sales administration, customer service or coordination.
- Strong organisation and the ability to manage several tasks at once.
- Confidence using IT systems and finding information from different sources.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and ownership of customer queries.
- Clear communication, resilience and a collaborative attitude.
- Commercial awareness and a commitment to excellent customer service.

Experience within manufacturing, distribution or a product-based business would be useful. Product knowledge isn't essential, as support will be provided.

What's on offer:
- 30,000- 31,000 basic salary.
- Eligibility for the company bonus scheme.
- Additional account management remuneration linked to team performance and objectives.
- A supportive team environment.

Interested? Apply today or message Lucy at TeamJobs to find out more.

title: Night Order Processor / Administrator
description:
Night Order Processor / Administrator

Location: Poole, Dorset
Job Type: Permanent
Salary:£25,272 per annum / £13.50 per hour
Hours:36 hours per week - 4 nights

Shift Pattern:
- Monday:9.00pm - 6.00am
- Tuesday:9.00pm - 6.00am
- Thursday:9.00pm - 6.00am
- Friday:7.00pm - 6.00am

30-minute unpaid break per shift.

We are recruiting a Night Order Processor / Administrator to join a well-established food distribution company based in Poole.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong administration, order processing or data entry experience who enjoys working in a busy environment. Accuracy is particularly important, as you will be responsible for processing customer orders received by voicemail and email ready for the following day's operation.

The Role

Working within the Night Sales Office, your responsibilities will include:
- Accurately entering customer orders onto the company's computer system.
- Listening to voicemail orders and interpreting information accurately.
- Processing orders received by email.
- Maintaining accurate records and filing systems.
- Carrying out general administration, scanning and document preparation.
- Assisting with customer price lists.
- Responding to queries from the night production team.
- Ensuring orders and administration are completed within required deadlines.
- Providing additional administrative support when required.

The Ideal Candidate

Previous experience within administration, order processing, data entry or customer service would be ideal.

You should have:
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Word and Excel.
- Strong data entry and numerical skills.
- Excellent listening and communication skills.
- The ability to work efficiently and independently during night hours.
- Good organisational and time-management skills.
- The ability to prioritise workloads in a fast-paced environment.
- A reliable and professional approach.
- The ability to learn new computer systems quickly.

What's on Offer
- £25,272 per annum / £13.50 per hour.
- Permanent position.
- 36-hour, four-night working week.
- Only four shifts per week.
- Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday nights off.
- Established and successful local employer.
- Varied administration and order processing position.

To apply for this permanent opportunity, please submit your latest CV and we will be in touch in due course. Alternatively, please contact Alan, Nikola or Anita for further information.

title: Office Administrator
description:
Job Type: Permanent

Location: Poole

Hours: 27.5 Hours Per Week (Flexible)

Competitive Salary & Benefits

At Hayley Dexis we ve built-up our reputation over the course of the last five decades with stock, service and people at the core of everything we do. As we enter an exciting period of growth our 1,400 people doing things the Hayley Way play a vital role in our ongoing success.

We re proud to be an equal opportunities employer, our people truly make the difference bringing energy, expertise, and passion that help us deliver outstanding service to our customers every single day.

We re excited to offer a brilliant opportunity for an enthusiastic Part-Time Office Administrator to join our well-established and experienced team based at our branch in Poole.

About the Office Administrator role:

As our Part Time Office Administrator, you'll play a key role in keeping the branch running smoothly behind the scenes. From processing customer and supplier transactions to managing invoices across various online platforms, you'll help ensure everything is organised, accurate, and up to date. You'll also support with online purchasing, order processing, payment administration, and credit card reconciliations, making sure the day-to-day paperwork stays firmly under control.

You'll be the go-to person for keeping outstanding orders on track, working closely with suppliers and customers to provide updates and resolve any issues. There'll also be opportunities to support the sales team by following up on customer quotations, assisting with branch telesales campaigns, and helping deliver excellent customer service.

No two days will be the same, as you'll also provide general administrative support across the branch. This could include arranging meetings, booking catering and meeting spaces, coordinating servicing and repairs for the Poole fleet, and helping with a variety of tasks that keep the office operating efficiently. If you're organised, proactive, and enjoy being at the heart of a busy team, you'll fit right in.

This is a part-time role working 27.5 hours per week. We're happy to offer flexibility around how these hours are worked, with days and start/finish times to be agreed with the successful candidate.

What we re looking for in our Office Administrator:
- Organised, accurate and detail-focused.
- Confident using Microsoft Office and computer systems.
- Strong communication and customer service skills.
- Able to juggle multiple tasks and prioritise effectively.
- Proactive, reliable and happy to work independently.
- A team player with a positive, can-do attitude.
- Previous administration experience would be advantageous.

What you ll get in return:
- From 23 days annual leave (plus public/bank holidays)
- Life assurance cover (x 2 salary)
- Invitation to healthcare schemes
- Company pension scheme
- Wellness programmes
- Uniform and PPE provided
- Training and development provided through our own Hayley Academy

What to expect from our recruitment process:
- Initial screening
- Microsoft Teams interview with our Talent Acquisition Advisor
- Face to face interview either in-person or Microsoft Teams
- Decision outcome

We ll close this role on Sunday 22nd November, but may do so earlier if we receive strong interest so don t miss out.

A final note

Not sure you tick every box? Please don t let that stop you from applying.

Need any reasonable adjustments? Just give our talent acquisition team a shout.

Any questions on your mind? Please reach out to us at (url removed)

title: Payroll Clerk
company: McGinnis Loy Associates Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Payroll Clerk / Payroll Advisor - SUPERB ROLE

McGinnis Loy Associates is proud to be working with a highly regarded Top 20 Accountancy Firm who are continuing to enjoy strong growth across the South West and South Coast region. They are now seeking a Payroll Administrator / Payroll Clerk to join their growing team in Poole who will be responsible for multiple client payrolls consisting of UK Ltd companies & partnerships. Reporting to the Payroll Manager, key duties include:
- Processing 30-50 client payrolls per month for third party employees on a weekly, fortnightly and/or monthly basis
- Calculating PAYE, NI, SSP, SMP, SPP and other payments on behalf of clients (eg student loans, travel loans, expense payments)
- Reconciling client payrolls and ensuring all payrolls processed are accurate and on time
- Calculating statutory maternity/paternity pay, sick pay and holiday pay entitlements for clients
- Setting up new payroll schemes for clients, supporting them through the first few payroll cycles
- Dealing with all client, employee and HMRC payroll queries
- Maintaining accurate employee records and checking payroll updates and their input through the system
- Ensuring all pay slips are processed and managing the submission of pay slip files
- Processing End Of Year client payrolls in accordance with client contracts and HMRC guidelines (P45s, P46s, P38s etc)
- Reconciliation of client monies and undertaking audits for data quality

To be considered for the role you should have hands-on experience working in a multi-client payroll environment, up to date knowledge of UK payroll regulations, year-end processes and UK payroll rules. You will be personally responsible for 30-50 client payrolls so you should have strong attention to detail, able to spot discrepancies, manage competing payroll deadlines, be confident communicating directly with clients and be able to work in a fast-paced payroll environment. Experience of working in another Accounting Firm or a Payroll Bureau would be a distinct advantage, as would expertise with different payroll systems such as PayCircle, Xero, Star Payroll etc.

On offer is a base salary to £31,000 depending on relevant experience, healthcare & pension schemes, 25 days holiday and other flexible benefits. To apply for the position, or for more information, please contact McGinnis Loy Associates (Reading) Office by telephone or via email. McGinnis Loy Associates Ltd is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy, in accordance with the Employment Agencies Act
